2944052904a3f1d170c46769c9c1fa5d7be23118.summary: Emsisoft page offering a free decryptor for GlobeImposter, a copycat of the Globe ransomware kit that imitates its ransom notes and file extension. Encrypted files get a .crypt extension with their base names unchanged, and a ransom note appears in every folder holding encrypted files. The tools are provided as-is, may only work with some ransomware versions, and get technical support only for paid Emsisoft customers.

tools.q: GlobeImposter is a Globe copycat that imitates the ransom notes and file extension found in the Globe

techniques.q: Encrypted files have the extension *.crypt and the base name of the file is unchanged.
The ransom note is named "HOW_OPEN_FILES.hta" and can be found in all folders that contain encrypted files.

hedges: these free tools are provided as-is and without warranty of any kind
The tools may only work with specific ransomware versions, and may not work with versions that were released after a tool was created.
Technical support for the tools is available only to customers using a paid Emsisoft product.
